decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive plays with Rakdos-colored creatures and spells to pressure the opponent quickly. It utilizes powerful cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threats efficiently. By combining strong creatures with disruptive spells, it aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays, supported by burn spells and combat tricks. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence, leveraging abilities like Monstrous Rage and Innkeeper's Talent to pump up creatures for maximum damage. With a mix of low-cost creatures and powerful effects like Reckless Rage and Burst Lightning, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize. The land base is optimized for fast mana production, allowing for consistent early aggression and pressure.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage and value through various card draw and token generation effects. With a few win conditions like Vanishing Verse and Stormchaser's Talent, the deck aims to stabilize the board and grind out a victory. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion offers additional card advantage and flexibility to the deck. In addition, the mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also providing some utility lands for additional value.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creature and burn spells, using efficient and powerful creatures like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Emberheart Challenger, along with removal spells like Reckless Rage and Burst Lightning. The deck also focuses on maximizing damage output with cards like Monstrous Rage and Innkeeper's Talent. The mana base is built to support the aggressive nature of the deck, with a mix of lands that produce red and green mana efficiently. The goal is to quickly outpace the opponent and finish them off before they can stabilize.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively play spells and cheap creatures to trigger the Arclight Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard to the battlefield. This deck focuses on filling the graveyard with spells through card draw and removal spells, while also utilizing cheap creatures like Picklock Prankster and Demilich to pressure the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Artist's Talent and Treasure Cruise help maintain card advantage, while Shivan Reef and Steam Vents provide the mana base needed to cast spells efficiently. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and consistent aggro strategy revolving around the powerful Arclight Phoenix.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with green creatures and enchantments to fuel powerful green spells and abilities. The goal is to swarm the board with creatures, generate massive amounts of mana with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. The inclusion of cards like Invasion of Ixalan and Storm the Festival further support this strategy by either putting more threats on the board or digging for key cards. The deck's synergy and devotion to green showcase its strength in aggressive gameplay.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of cheap creatures and burn spells to deal damage quickly. It utilizes cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Emberheart Challenger, and Heartfire Hero to put pressure on the opponent while using spells like Fatal Push and Reckless Rage to control the board. The inclusion of Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Screaming Nemesis provides additional damage output, aiming to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance give additional reach in the late game, ensuring the deck has ways to close out the game efficiently.

The main idea behind this Aggro Red Deck Wins deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By playing low-cost creatures like Soul-Scar Mage and Monastery Swiftspear, and combining them with pump spells like Infuriate and Titan's Strength, you can deal a large amount of damage in a short amount of time. Additionally, cards like Thud and Ramunap Ruins allow you to finish off your opponent even if they stabilize with blockers. Overall, this deck aims to be fast and efficient in dealing damage to win the game as quickly as possible.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It includes low-cost creatures like Callous Sell-Sword and Slickshot Show-Off, along with pump spells like Infuriate to increase their damage output. The deck also utilizes cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Kumano, Faces Kakkazan to deal direct damage to the opponent. With a mix of creatures and burn spells, this deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game and close out the match swiftly.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries in order to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. The deck utilizes spells like Lightning Axe, Fiery Impulse, and Treasure Cruise to help enable this strategy. There are also cards like Picklock Prankster and Consider to help dig through the deck and find key pieces. With a mix of aggressive creatures and efficient spells, the deck aims to be a fast, proactive deck that can overwhelm opponents early in the game.

This deck is focused on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Human creatures. It utilizes cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thalia's Lieutenant to disrupt the opponent's plans and pump up the team. With cards like Recruitment Officer and Reflector Mage providing additional utility, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace and put pressure on the opponent early in the game. The mana base is carefully curated to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors and types of mana for the deck.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger to deal damage quickly. It also includes burn spells like Monstrous Rage and Fatal Push to control the board and finish off opponents. Den of the Bugbear provides additional creature threats while Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance offers a powerful effect to further pressure opponents. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of creature damage and burn spells to secure victory in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly build up green devotion to maximize the effectiveness of cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Collected Company. By playing aggressive creatures like Abhorrent Oculus, Old-Growth Troll, and Werewolf Pack Leader, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like Polukranos Reborn and Tyvar, the Pummeler provide additional power and utility to the deck. With mana ramp from Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, the deck can quickly deploy threats and outpace the opponent. The lands Lair of the Hydra, Boseiju, Who Endures, and Botanical Sanctum provide additional utility to support the overall game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with a mix of efficient creatures and disruptive spells. By playing low-cost creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, the deck can quickly ramp up and overwhelm the opponent with threats like Archon of Emeria and Skyclave Apparition. Thalia, Guardian of Thraben provides additional disruption by taxing noncreature spells. Collected Company allows the deck to further flood the board with creatures. Overall, the deck aims to win the game by applying relentless pressure and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disruption and removal, aiming to control the board and hand of the opponent. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Narset, Parter of Veils, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while drawing cards and maintaining card advantage. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by blinking permanents and triggering enter-the-battlefield effects. The mana base includes a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistent mana sources for the spells in the deck.

The main focus of this Esper Control deck is to control the game through a combination of card advantage, disruption, and removal spells. With cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan, and powerful threats like Narset, Parter of Veils and Yorion, Sky Nomad to generate card advantage, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and ultimately win through attrition. The deck also utilizes a mix of lands and pathways to ensure consistent mana base and efficient color fixing.
